mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing ropinirole metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, with potential enhancement of dopaminergic adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased ropinirole side effects (nausea, dizziness, hallucinations, orthostatic hypotension); consider dose reduction of ropinirole or use alternative alcohol deterrent if clinically feasible.
